SchemaEntry.description: A single schema entry with its resolved metadata, content, and dependency edges.

content.description: The full JSON Schema content, inline. In v1, this is always populated. In future versions, may be null for very large schemas — plugins should fall back to reading content_ref when content is null.

content_ref.description: Relative file path from the project root to the schema on disk (e.g. '.rusl/schemas/rusl/common.json'). In v1, always populated alongside content. Plugins may read this file directly instead of using the inline content.

dependencies.description: Direct dependency names in account/slug format. These correspond to other entries in the schemas array. Plugins can use this to build import graphs or resolve $ref pointers.

kind.description: Source type of the dependency. 'schema' is a registry-published JSON Schema, 'bundle' is a logical grouping package, 'external' is an HTTP-sourced schema.

name.description: Fully qualified schema name in account/slug format (e.g. 'rusl/common', 'forms/contact').

target.description: true if this schema matched the generator's filter globs (or if no filter is configured), false if included only as a transitive dependency. Plugins typically only generate output for target schemas but may use non-target schemas for type references and imports.

description: The JSON payload that rusl pipes to a generator plugin's stdin. Contains the protocol version, user-configured options, and the resolved schema graph in reverse topological order (leaves first).

options.description: Contents of [generators.<name>.args] from the user's rusl.config.toml. Opaque to rusl — the structure is defined by each plugin. Plugins should document their supported options and validate this object themselves.

schemas.description: Ordered array of schemas in reverse topological order (leaves first, roots last). When processing schema N, all schemas that N depends on are guaranteed to appear earlier in the array.

version.description: Protocol version. Plugins should check this value and exit with code 2 if unsupported.
